preReview.title: Seattle Sounders have timed MLS revival to perfection, says Brunell
preReview.description: The Seattle Sounders have gone from losing eight games in a row to going unbeaten in eight, ahead of Sunday's clash with New England.

preReview.title: Seattle Sounders resurge en el momento perfecto, afirma Brunell
preReview.description: Seattle Sounders ha pasado de ocho derrotas consecutivas a ocho partidos invicto antes de recibir el domingo a New England

preReview.title: Seattle Sounders, la rinascita in MLS arriva al momento giusto secondo Brunell
preReview.description: Dopo otto sconfitte consecutive, la squadra dei Seattle Sounders non perde da otto partite in vista della sfida di domenica contro New England.

preReview.title: Seattle Sounders reagiu na hora certa na MLS, diz Brunell
preReview.description: Após oito derrotas seguidas, o Seattle Sounders está invicto há oito jogos antes do duelo de domingo contra o New England.

preReview.title: Selon Brunell, les Seattle Sounders se relancent au moment idéal en MLS
preReview.description: Après huit défaites consécutives, les Seattle Sounders restent sur huit matches sans revers avant d'affronter New England dimanche.

preReview.title: Brunell: Seattle Sounders kommt in der MLS genau zur rechten Zeit in Fahrt
preReview.description: Nach acht Niederlagen in Folge ist Seattle Sounders nun seit acht Spielen ungeschlagen. Am Sonntag wartet das Duell gegen New England.

preReview.title: برونيل: سياتل ساوندرز استعاد مستواه في الوقت المناسب بالدوري الأميركي
preReview.description: سياتل ينهض بعد ثماني هزائم متتالية ويخوض مواجهة نيو إنجلاند الأحد بسجل من ثماني مباريات بلا خسارة

preReview.title: Seattle Sounders reage na MLS na altura certa, diz Brunell
preReview.description: Após oito derrotas consecutivas, o Seattle Sounders está há oito jogos sem perder antes do duelo de domingo com o New England.
